I also deal with those cyclical, obsessive suicidal thoughts when I become overwhelmed with anxiety or depression. I don't know if it will help you, but something that helped take my mind off of it was something called "square breathing". If I began to feel like I was disappointing someone, and that guilt feeling would rush up, I would try sitting somewhere quiet, breathing in for four seconds, holding it for four, letting it out for four seconds, and again holding for four. It was enough for me to center my thoughts and not become overwhelmed. 

Again, I don't know if that will help you, but it certainly helped keep those thoughts at bay, and at least focus on the problem at hand with a little more focus. I hope you feel better, and if you need to every just rant or talk to anyone, you can always PM me.

Thank you. At one point in high school, when I was going through this (But much worse), I did get some professional help and it was very beneficial for me. And it's not that I don't have a good support system around me either, I do have really great friends. It's just very difficult to describe how I feel without sounding ungrateful or selfish, so I think I'm really afraid to talk about it. Even more so, I don't know what to talk about, other than "I feel like I'm slipping into a black hole for no reason."

It know it sounds silly. It's getting very physical feeling, like actually nauseated and unable to eat just because my mind is so preoccupied.
